fullTextEN: Hello everyone, this is XiaoguaChinese.
I am Jiaqi.

fullTextZH: 今天呢，我们来看一张很奇怪的照片。
fullTextEN: Today, we are going to look at a very strange photo.

fullTextZH: 然后我给大家讲一个很奇怪的故事。
fullTextEN: Then I will tell everyone a very strange story.
This boy,
His name is Juan.
His hair is very curly.
He has a white beard.

fullTextZH: 你们觉得他是哪个国家的人呢？
fullTextEN: Which country do you think he is from?
Could he be British?
I don't think so.

fullTextZH: 他的名字听起来不是英文名字。
fullTextEN: His name doesn't sound like an English name.

fullTextZH: 他听起来和看起来都是一个西班牙人。
fullTextEN: He sounds and looks like a Spaniard.
Right?
Okay.
Let's see what Juan is doing.
He is looking at his phone.
He might be watching a video.
Because he is also wearing headphones.
He is wearing headphones.
So where is Juan?

fullTextZH: 我们可以看到照片上有一个浴缸。
fullTextEN: We can see there is a bathtub in the photo.
A bathtub is a place for bathing.
And there's a toilet.
A place for using the toilet.
So Juan is in the bathroom now.
But is Juan taking a bath?
Is he taking a bath?
No.
Is he using the toilet?
Also no.
Juan is in the bathroom looking at his phone.

fullTextZH: 然后他的手放在卫生间的杆子上。
fullTextEN: Then his hand is on the bathroom rod.
Why is this?

fullTextZH: 你们觉得欢这个人奇怪吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think Juan is strange?
I think he is really strange.

fullTextZH: 他为什么不在沙发上看手机？
fullTextEN: Why doesn't he look at his phone on the sofa?
Why does he have to look at his phone in the bathroom?

fullTextZH: 为什么他的手放在杆子上？
fullTextEN: Why is his hand on the rod?
Where do you think it is?
Do people do such things?
Let me tell everyone.
As for this photo,
It was taken during the time of COVID.
So at that time,
Because Juan couldn't go out to work,
He couldn't go out to work,
He could only stay at home.
But,

fullTextZH: Juan是一个每天都要坐地铁去上班的人。
fullTextEN: Juan is someone who takes the subway to work every day.

fullTextZH: 他每天都要在地铁上看手机，
fullTextEN: He has to look at his phone on the subway every day,
Watch videos, wearing headphones.
And when looking at his phone,

fullTextZH: 手要放在地铁的杆子上。
fullTextEN: His hand has to be on the subway pole.
So now, suddenly one day,
He doesn't need to,
He doesn't need to go to work anymore.
But he feels very uncomfortable,
He feels very uncomfortable.
He feels it's not okay,

fullTextZH: 我的手，我的手放在哪里？
fullTextEN: Where do I put my hands?

fullTextZH: 我的手要放到杆子上面，
fullTextEN: I need to put my hands on the pole,
Then I need to look at my phone,
I need to wear headphones,
I need to watch videos.
Where do I watch videos?
So Juan thinks:

fullTextZH: 如果我不可以出去做这些事情，
fullTextEN: If I can't go out to do these things,

fullTextZH: 那我要在家里做这些事情。
fullTextEN: Then I will do these things at home.
Because for Juan,

fullTextZH: 有一个不变的日常是最重要的。
fullTextEN: Having an unchanging routine is most important.

fullTextZH: 可能我们很多人都有在covid的时候，
fullTextEN: Maybe many of us had during covid,
The experience of not being able to go out.

fullTextZH: 所以你们都是在家做什么呢？
fullTextEN: So what did you all do at home?
During covid, I couldn't go out.
So I read books at home,
I sang at home,
I listened to music at home.

fullTextZH: 但是我不需要戴耳机听音乐。
fullTextEN: But I don't need to wear headphones to listen to music.

fullTextZH: 我还在家看电视、看电影。
fullTextEN: I also watched TV and movies at home.

fullTextZH: 做了很多很多很多的事情。
fullTextEN: Did a lot, a lot, a lot of things.
So,

fullTextZH: 你们在Covid的时候有没有什么好玩的，
fullTextEN: Did you have any fun during Covid,
any strange experiences?
You can tell me.
See you next time.
Bye bye.
